title: Day 26: What Today’s Buyers Actually Want (Seller Perspective)
excerpt: Buyers in 2026 prioritize move-in condition, transparent disclosures, realistic pricing, and functional updates over heavy personalization.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “what buyers want in a home 2026 Austin”, “features that sell houses Central Texas”, and “move-in ready homes Austin” want a local, practical answer.

Buyers in 2026 prioritize move-in condition, transparent disclosures, realistic pricing, and functional updates over heavy personalization.

Clean mechanicals, neutral finishes, good natural light, and outdoor living space consistently rank high.

Homes that feel like projects require deeper discounts or credits.

Sellers who present a home that reduces perceived risk win more showings and stronger offers.
